title: Length bound after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $x,u,r$ be finite binary strings and let $p$ be a natural number. If deleting the first $p$ entries of $x$ leaves the concatenation of $u$ and $r$, and $u$ is nonempty, then $p+|u|\le |x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ with its first $p$ entries removed equals $u$ followed by $r$
